title: Novell ZENworks Mobile Management DUSAP.php Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Novell ZENworks Mobile Management . Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within DUSAP.php, which receives a 'language' variable which later is used to include arbitrary resources from the local filesystem via require_once(). A remote attacker can abuse this to execute remote code under the context of the process running.
